text:
marcos: Quick heads-up 80 I pushed a tiny patch to the migration guide to add a 'break-glass' rollback section and a short curl example for toggling fallbacks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/975

annie: Nice. Can you include the exact curl snippet? Something like:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"route":"/v1-fallback","to":"v1"}'`

kevin: I'll convert that into a TS SDK example and add an async-iterator-safe retry wrapper for streaming reads (handles partial JSON chunks).

marcos: Please also call out audit log entries and recommended rate-limit while rolling back to protect capacity.

liz: Confirm timelines still match PR description (announce 2026-05-01, migrate by 2026-08-01, shutdown 2026-09-01). If the rollback snippet mentions dates, use the canonical ones.

kevin: Added the snippet and a tiny helper `normalizeStreamChunks()` in examples dir. Pushed to branch.

docs-bot: New PR check: add `owner:kevin` and `smoke-test:required` labels.

annie: I'll review the wording for clarity and add a one-line customer blurb for the banner once the snippet is final.

marcos: thanks team. If CI green, let's merge and announce planned office hours for May.
